name: NewSharedPropertyDialog
intent: Author a property reused across object types: display name, API name, base type, formatting and type classes.
when: Declaring a property several object types will share
Any create flow whose validation rules differ per host
whenNot: Adding a property to one object type -> do it on that type's detail page

chooseOver.because: Validation is a prop: the default is display-name-required, and a host needing more — a required API name, a uniqueness check — passes the full rule set in the order it wants them reported.

validate.note: Return a message to block creation. Defaults to display-name-required only.

dataContract.rowIdentity: Drafts carry no id; the host mints one on accept.

states.default: Display name, slugified API name, base type string.
states.refused: The validate rule's message is shown and creation is held.

evaluationCriteria: The host's validate rules are reported in the order the host gave them.

lineage.authoredBy: Promoted in group C of the missing-widgets template review (2026-08-26)
notes: Already an exported component with a typed props interface and no fixture coupling — this manifest is the only thing that was missing.
